_comment: Frozen eval suite (docs/iteration-architecture.md steps 5-6, codenames/eval_suite.py). board_seeds is a fixed list, not a count -- a rerun or an extension must reproduce the exact same boards for seeds already used, so results stay comparable and cache hits actually hit. Boards are built from codenames.board.load_holdout_wordlist() (150 of 400 words, none seen in training), not the full 400-word list. `guesser` is one fixed LLM guesser as a spec (codenames/guessers/registry.py::build_guesser) and is part of the suite's identity (EvalSuite.suite_id): switching model or effort makes old numbers non-comparable, per docs/iteration-architecture.md's "two roles for guessers". Sonnet rather than Opus on cost -- 25 paired positions showed no detectable difference at about a fifth of the price (docs/log.md, "Sonnet vs. Opus as the evaluation guesser"); Opus is reserved for the final headline numbers. Extending board_seeds does NOT change suite_id -- only the newly-added seeds get played.
name: holdout_v1
